<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Images drawn by the app, on the server: internal/platform/images, a small kit to draw them with (a canvas, colors, rectangles with round corners, text in a font by name that wraps, shrinks and ends in an ellipsis, a picture contained or covering a box, PNG), in pure Go (golang.org/x/image), and a cache of what it drew in the storage blueprint's store. The fonts are a site's brand's (its TrueType or OpenType files; a variable font in its default instance) or, without one, the Go fonts. Its first use: @site(page, og_image) on an entity gives each record's page an Open Graph image, /&lt;path>/&lt;id>/og.png, 1200x630, drawn by &lt;entity>_og.go, yours, and kept in the store until the record changes. Projects draw their own images with the same kit.

```esquadro
blueprint images
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [storage](../storage/): the app must use them too.

## Go modules

- `golang.org/x/image` v0.43.0
